summary: Retest of the iteration_69 fixes plus a regression run. Backend: the new test_iter70_retest_fixes.py passes 14/14 and iter69 passes 13/13, so 27/27 when run with -n 0. With xdist in parallel, 2 tests cross-interfere because they share the tester balance; this is a test-isolation effect, not an app bug. Verified fixes: (1) /admin/cash-balances. The UI deposit works (300->301, toast 'Buchung gespeichert.'), only credit types are offered, the balance column shows the real ledger balance, and 422 errors are readable. (2) GET /api/admin/portfolio/orders lists orders with customer name, email and Guthaben in /admin/stock-orders (Ausstehend 3, Alle 39). (3) Bank logos appear in the /admin offers table, the /admin/offers table (298 rows), the /admin/users/<id> contract list, /admin/depot-contracts (user name and email plus bank name are now shown) and customer Vermögen 'Größte Verträge'. All logo files return 200; naturalWidth 0 only for lazy offscreen images. (4) Bond fields are correct. Anleihen shows Einstand 1.970, Ø Kupon 2,10 %, Fälligkeit 15.02.2032, Kaufdatum; Übersicht G/V is +0,00. (5) Kontoauszug: Festgeld/Tagesgeld are included (Gesamtvermögen 18.770), debits are negative, the running Saldo is consistent, types are in German, pending rows show '(vorgemerkt)' with Saldo '–', and the bond name is shown. (6) A Festgeld with laufzeit but no end date gets a derived end date: 2026-08-31 + 6 months gives 2027-02-28, both via the API and via the admin asset panel UI. (7) AktienPage now shows €. (8) A bad IBAN checksum gives 422 (UI toast 'Bitte eine gültige IBAN angeben'); the error amount is German ('300,00 €'); 4 parallel payout requests give exactly one 201 and no overdraw. (9) The sidebar payout badge goes 1 to empty right after approve. (10) Tagesgeld term shows 'täglich' and rates have 2 decimals. Regression: the payout flow end to end (customer UI request -> admin UI approve, plus reject and double-approve 409 via API) works, admin asset panel add/delete works, all 19 /dashboard and all 38 /admin sidebar links load with no page errors or API errors. New bugs found: the stock live price is ignored in the customer dashboard (HIGH), the admin cash-balances history modal is always empty, and the Kontoauszug contract table has empty bank names. All seeded data was cleaned up; the final tester state is cash 300.00 / available 300.00, no assets, no pending payouts.

minor.issue: Returns only {balance, available, unsettled, open_buy_reservations, currency} with no history. AdminCashBalances.js:150-154 reads data.history, so the admin 'Verlauf' modal always shows 'Keine Buchungen vorhanden'. Either add history (get_cash_history) to this endpoint or add a dedicated admin history endpoint.

The admin debit endpoint still exists and works (direction=debit), although the owner rule says payouts only via customer request + admin approval. The UI no longer uses it. Consider restricting it to credit or removing debit.

Summary total_value (5348.40) excludes contracts and accrued interest, while Übersicht and Mein Depot show 19.126,10. Kontoauszug and admin user detail show 18.770 (principal without accrued interest). Gesamtvermögen therefore differs across 3 screens, which is inconsistent.

The per-user asyncio.Lock is in-process only. It works with the current --workers 1, but breaks with more than 1 worker or replica in production. A Mongo conditional write or unique pending marker would be more robust.

ui_bugs.issue: stockPriceMap is always set to {} and stockMetrics ignores p.price/market_value, which /api/portfolio/stock-positions already returns (AAPL price 307.84, market_value 3078.40). Every customer stock is valued at cost: Aktien Kurs '–', G/V +0,00 €, Marktwert 1.500 €. At the same time Mein Depot 'GESAMT G/V' uses the server summary profit_loss and shows +1.578,40 € (+45,49 %). These contradict each other on the same page set. Fix: in stockMetrics use p.price as the market price fallback (or fill stockPriceMap from positions).

The 'Verlauf' modal is always empty because the endpoint returns no history (see backend). Also, line ~405 positive = Number(r.amount) >= 0 ignores direction, so once history is loaded, debits would show as green '+'. Apply direction for the sign and hide cancelled rows.

In the Festgeld/Tagesgeld table, Bank shows '–' because it reads c.bank_name while /api/portfolio/depot-contracts returns banks.name. Use c.banks?.name. The Typ column shows raw lowercase 'tagesgeld'/'festgeld'.

Reads cashSummary from context, but the context has no cashSummary (only cashAvailable), so 'Verfügbar: 0,00 €' flashes until its own fetch completes. Use cashAvailable from context as the initial value.
Uses raw /api/portfolio/cash history amounts (unsigned + direction), so isCredit is always true and debits would be titled 'Gutschrift'. Apply direction.
Calls /admin/users?include_balances=true without limit=500 (default 50), so with more than 50 users some orders show customer '–'. Still swallows errors with .catch(() => ({data: []})).

issues: The visitor-welcome cookie gate still appears for logged-in admins on every /admin/* page (not fixed since iter69).
Percentages use an English decimal point ('+0.00 %', '3.1% p.a.', '2.50%') on Aktien, Anleihen KURS-G/V, Vermögen 'Größte Verträge' and the Kontoauszug Zins column, while the rest uses German commas.
Kontoauszug and the admin asset panel still use native mm/dd/yyyy date pickers; the admin asset panel list shows ISO dates ('AB 2026-08-31').
Many leftover QA ledger rows ('TEST debit', 'TEST restore payout', 'TEST_iter70 Einzahlung') are visible to the tester customer. The ledger is append-only, so this cannot be undone.

action_items: HIGH: DashboardDataContext stockMetrics should use p.price/p.market_value from /api/portfolio/stock-positions (stockPriceMap is never filled), so Aktien, Übersicht and Mein Depot match the server summary G/V.
MEDIUM: Add ledger history to GET /api/admin/portfolio/cash/summary (or a new endpoint) for the AdminCashBalances Verlauf modal, and apply the direction sign there.
MEDIUM: Statement.js:323 should use c.banks?.name, and translate the product_type label.
LOW: PayoutRequestDialog initial available should use cashAvailable; NotificationCenter sign should use direction; AdminStockOrders users fetch should use limit=500.

LOW: Decide whether the admin debit /cash/adjustment should remain; unify the Gesamtvermögen definition (with or without accrued interest) across Kontoauszug, admin user detail and the dashboard; use German % formatting; stop the welcome gate on /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: _PAYOUT_LOCKS defaultdict grows unbounded (one Lock per user ever seen) and is process-local.
admin_list_orders has no user/email enrichment server-side; the frontend relies on a separate users list with a default limit of 50.

Statement.js running Saldo starts from the current cash_balance and walks back over at most 50 rows. This is correct for the displayed window, but if a date filter is applied, the Saldo would be wrong unless the history is newest-first and complete up to now.
AdminCashBalances still has the dead _unused_openHistory_legacy function and unused TX_META entries.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all 10 retested fixes verified; 1 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM new bugs)

rca of the issue: Stock valuation: the Phase-1 comment in DashboardDataContext ('Preisdaten liefert Phase 2') left stockPriceMap empty, while the backend later began embedding live prices into stock-positions. The frontend never adopted them, but DepotKpiRail uses the server summary, hence the contradictory G/V. Admin history modal: the frontend expects history in cash/summary, but the backend summary endpoint only returns totals. Statement bank: the field name mismatch is bank_name vs banks.name.
